# hx-lite

> HX-lite is an enterprise Harness control framework for governed, auditable AI-assisted software delivery ("Vibe Coding"). It pairs a central WebUI (organization-level governance) with a local CLI called `nhx` (project-level sync and execution).

## Core concepts

- **Guide**: a reusable, organization-defined standard, template, or instruction set that AI agents follow during a task (feed-forward control).
- **Sensor**: a validation/check rule that observes task execution and reports compliance (feedback control).
- **Stage / Task**: the unit of delivery work to which Guides and Sensors attach.
- **nhx**: the local CLI projects use to pull organizational assets (Guides/Sensors) and execute delivery tasks with traceability.

## Problems it solves

- Requirements and acceptance criteria drifting as they pass through a delivery chain
- Organizational standards/templates/review rules that can't be reused across projects
- AI-assisted development decisions and changes that aren't auditable
- Disconnected roles (PM, architect, developer, QA) with no shared control plane

## Architecture

WebUI (org-level asset governance: Stage/Task, Guide, Sensor) <-> nhx (project-level sync, projection, local execution). Both share the same rule and state model.

## Quick start

```
git clone https://github.com/llm-insights-share/hx-lite.git
cd hx-lite
npm install
npm install -g .
nhx --help
```
